_doc: Sample content for composition previews (scripts/composition_preview.js). One pack per kind of business, so a preview shows a direction on content that belongs to a real subject instead of one agency sample. All names, numbers and prices are invented samples; previews say so. h1 is [before, emphasised, after]. Photos are keys of assets/photos/.

cafe.kicker: Specialty coffee, roasted in the shop
cafe.sub: Small lots from four farms we visit every harvest. Taste them at the bar, take a bag home, or have it on your doorstep by Friday.
pillars: Doi Chang, Guji, Huila and Nyeri. We know each picker crew by name.
Green coffee rests 14 days; every lot is cupped before it reaches the menu.
Printed on every bag. Best from day 5 to day 30.
cafe.q: Light roast or medium for a morning pour-over?
cafe.answer: Start with the Guji washed lot at medium-light: bright, tea-like, forgiving on a home grinder.

architecture.sub: Deep eaves, cross-ventilation and concrete that ages well. We design houses, schools and small public buildings for the tropics.
pillars: Every plan starts with where the sun lands at 3 pm in April.
Cross-ventilation designed before the air-conditioning is sized.
Board-formed concrete, teak, laterite; nothing that needs repainting.
architecture.q: Can a school stay cool without air-conditioning?
architecture.answer: Mae Rim primary runs 4.2°C below outdoor peak with eaves, a stack-vent roof and planted courts.

saas.sub: Halden runs your queues, schedules and webhooks with per-job traces, cost per run and replays that don't double-charge customers.
pillars: Idempotency keys on every step, so a replay never sends two invoices.
Each job shows its compute and API spend before the bill does.
One timeline per job across retries, workers and regions.
saas.q: Why did 214 invoices go out twice last Tuesday?
saas.answer: A retried webhook without an idempotency key. Halden blocks the second send and shows the trace.

clinic.kicker: Physiotherapy for desk backs and weekend knees
clinic.sub: A 60-minute assessment, a plan you can follow at home, and the same therapist every visit until you're done.
pillars: You see the same person from first visit to discharge.
Three exercises a day, filmed on your phone in the session.
We agree what 'done' looks like at the first visit.
clinic.q: How many sessions does a stiff lower back usually need?
clinic.answer: Most desk-related back pain settles in 4 to 6 visits with daily home exercises.

h1: , and what would change our mind.
consultancy.sub: We write the memo your board actually decides on: a single recommendation, the numbers behind it, and the conditions that would reverse it.
pillars: The recommendation and its cost fit on page one.
Every figure links to its source table.
We name what would make the decision wrong.
consultancy.q: Should we enter Vietnam this year or wait for the licence?
consultancy.answer: Wait. Enter in Q2 next year with the licence; the cost of waiting is $1.1M, the cost of an early exit is $6M.

publisher.kicker: A quarterly about type, print and the people who set it
publisher.sub: Three shops still set Thai and Chinese type by hand. We spent a season at their cases, and printed this issue on their presses.
pillars: Four essays of 6,000 words, set to read on paper.
Letterpress covers, risograph inserts, a fold-out specimen.
Every contributor is paid on acceptance.
publisher.q: Who still sets Thai type by hand, and for whom?
publisher.answer: Three shops, mostly wedding cards and temple notices. One has a waiting list of design students.

festival.kicker: Four nights, four stages, no phones on the dance floor
festival.sub: Forty-two artists across four stages, a forest camp, and a 6 am closing set you'll lie about missing.
pillars: Field, Forest, Pond and the 6 am Sunrise stage.
Tents, cabins and cold showers that actually work.
Pouches at the gate. You'll thank us on Monday.
festival.q: Is the 6 am sunrise set worth staying up for?
festival.answer: Yes. Bring a jacket, it's 19°C by the pond.

streetfood.kicker: Five stalls, one alley, open until two
streetfood.sub: Pork skewers, crab omelette and mango sticky rice from the same five families who have cooked in this alley for 38 years.
pillars: Each stall cooks one thing and has for decades.
No gas grills; the smoke is the point.
From six in the evening to two in the morning.
streetfood.answer: Moo ping and sticky rice from Auntie Jiab, then the crab omelette while you queue for mango.

ceramics.kicker: Stoneware thrown and fired in Lampang
h1: of the hand that made them.
ceramics.sub: Everyday stoneware, wood-fired every six weeks. Buy from the current firing, commission a set, or learn the wheel on a weekend.
pillars: A two-day firing in a 1987 anagama kiln; ash glazes every piece differently.
Around 300 pieces a firing, most gone in a week.
Six students, two days, you take home what survives the kiln.
ceramics.q: Why does every cup look different?
ceramics.answer: Wood ash lands where the flame carries it. No two pieces sit in the same draught.

fintech.kicker: A current account that explains itself
fintech.sub: Bills, transfers and card spend sorted the moment they happen, with a plain sentence for anything that looks unusual.
pillars: Each payment lands in a category before you put your phone down.
"Your electricity bill is 38% higher than March." Not a red dot.
Free transfers, free card, a ฿0 monthly fee.
fintech.q: Why is this month ฿4,200 higher than last?
fintech.answer: Your electricity bill rose ฿1,900 and two annual subscriptions renewed on the 3rd.

data.sub: Station rainfall from 122 weather stations, compared with the 2015–2024 average, by region and by week.
pillars: Every station with ten years of daily readings.
Each figure compares with the same week from 2015 to 2024.
Every chart has a CSV and the query behind it.
data.q: Is the north heading for a dry season like 2019?
data.answer: Drier than 2019 by week 46, but reservoirs are 11 points fuller.

school.kicker: Type and layout, taught in the evening
school.sub: Thai and Latin typography, grids and print production, taught by working designers to classes of twelve.
pillars: Every piece of work gets a full critique.
Both scripts, side by side, from the first week.
Term ends with a risograph booklet you set yourself.
school.q: Do I need design experience to join?
school.answer: No. Half of each class are writers, developers or marketers.

retreat.kicker: Twelve cabins in the cloud forest
retreat.sub: Twelve wooden cabins at 1,400 metres, a wood-fired kitchen, and mornings when the valley disappears under the mist.
pillars: Each with a stove, a deck and no neighbours in view.
Dinner from the farms on the next ridge.
retreat.q: When is the mist most reliable?
retreat.answer: Mid-December to late January, from about 6 to 9 in the morning.

bar.kicker: Eighteen seats, one turntable, records from 1965 to 1985
bar.sub: A listening bar for Thai luk thung, Japanese city pop and Lagos funk on original pressings, through a 1974 valve system.
pillars: Mekhong, Chalong Bay and twelve local craft gins.
bar.answer: Side A of Suraphon Sombatcharoen, 1968, then Tatsuro Yamashita until midnight.

dental.kicker: Family dentistry, one booking for the whole house
dental.sub: Pick who is coming, the treatment and a time with a free chair for everyone. We confirm on LINE within 30 minutes.
pillars: The dentist explains the plan and the price before any work starts.
Children are seen in the same slot as a parent, not after a long wait.
Social-security patients use the yearly dental allowance without paying first.
dental.q: When should a child first see the dentist?
dental.answer: When the first tooth appears, and before the first birthday.
rows: Social security, up to ฿900 a year
